messages:
morgan: Quick sync — I want to lock the onboarding ops slate and the set of "burning questions" we’ll use for the next DP wave. We need: recruitment criteria, incentive options, measurement hooks, and clear exit criteria. Can we do a rapid pass here?
alejandra: +1, have some new constraints from legal on incentive caps. can we list tiered options?
sam_k: I sketched a few recruitment buckets earlier — PM-focused, platform integrators, and data-privacy customers. shortlist = 30 total seats.
vlad: For measurement hooks: want automated prompt-eval flows + NPS + weekly qualitative 15-min interviews. also need commit to a rollback SLA if quality dips.
emily_pd: I like the 15-min interviews. can we make the weekly auto-eval include a baseline and a pass/fail threshold? need clear triggers for canary/rollback.
morgan: Draft checklist for the slate (quick):
```
- Seats: 30 (10 PM, 10 Integrators, 10 Regulated)
- Incentives: credit + gift card OR extended support (tiered)
- Eval hooks: weekly automated prompts, 15-min interview, monthly NPS
- Exit criteria: <60% pass rate on core prompts after 2 weeks -> pause rollout
- Rollout policy: canary (10%), expand to 50% if pass, full at 90% pass
```
alejandra: Legal prefers no more than $200 gift card per org; credits > support might be easier. suggest opt-in for extended support as non-monetary incentive.
sam_k: Recruitment script snippet: "short use-case, integration timeline, data handling Qs, required contact person". I can paste a doc later.
vlad: On the automated eval: can we tag prompts by failure mode (hallucination, latency, formatting)? that'll help root cause.
emily_pd: +1. also add instrumentation to log model variant + quantization profile used for each request so we can correlate regressions to infra changes.
morgan: Good call. note to ops-bot: create an invite channel and add DP cohort list when we finalize seats.
ops-bot: @morgan created channel #dp-wave-8-invites and added placeholder invite template. (deploy-id: dp-invite-8) :white_check_mark:
alejandra: Final ask: can we add a short opt-out / exit survey for churn reasons? we want to capture friction vs. product mis-match.
sam_k: I'll own outreach cadence. propose 3-touch: email invite, reminder + 2-day nudge, final confirmation.
vlad: Sizing note: dedicated SRE on call for first 72 hours of launch. also ensure canary route has fallback to hosted model variant.
emily_pd: I can codify the pass/fail thresholds and create the prompt set. throwing one question: do we want to include pricing sensitivity experiment in cohort?
morgan: Not in wave 1, keep product fidelity focus. Wave 2 we can A/B pricing. For wave 1: action items:
- sam_k: finalize recruitment script + cadence (due in 48h)
- emily_pd: upload prompt set + thresholds (48h)
- alejandra: confirm legal wording on incentives (24h)
- vlad: confirm SRE coverage + fallback routes (24h)
- ops-bot: seed invite channel with template (done)
morgan: If no objections, I'll lock this slate EOD. :calendar: any major concerns?
alejandra: none from me, once legal ok.
sam_k: good with seats and cadence.
vlad: fine, will ping infra to schedule oncall.
emily_pd: ran a quick smoke on the prompt set, looks sane. will finish thresholds.
morgan: Great — locking for now. we'll reconvene after the 48h actions. thanks all. :tada:
